'''Taku Yashiro''' (Japanese: '''八代拓''' ''Yashiro Taku'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Yashiro was born on January 6, 1993, and is affiliated with VIMS talent agency. Yashiro became a voice actor in 2013 and first worked on Pokémon, voicing [[Gordie]] in {{pkmn|Masters EX}}. Yashiro joined {{aniseries|HZ}}, voicing [[Friede]].
